ソロモンは父ダビデに代わって王座に就き、イスラエルは彼に従ったと記されています。

wikipediaLinkAdditions.locator: “Genesis 25” section, lines 113–120: set-index introduction distinguishes several Hebrew names sharing the KJV transliteration; this section identifies Shuah as a son of Abraham and Keturah and reference 4 cites 1 Chronicles 1:32.
Lead, lines 118–119: distinguishes an Edomite clan and its eponym; says Teman son of Eliphaz and grandchild of Esau. Article also discusses a geographic Teman town separately.
Lead, lines 104–106: Lotan son of Seir; says his sister Timna became Eliphaz’s concubine and bore Amalek; explicitly notes the text may refer to two people named Timna.
“Biblical characters with this name” lines 111–114: first Uzzi entry is son of Bukki, descendant of Aaron, cites 1 Chronicles 6:5, 51 and Ezra 7:4.
“Biblical characters with this name” lines 131–132: identifies Uzzi as grandson of Issachar and cites 1 Chronicles 7:2–3; the following entry distinguishes Benjamin’s Uzzi.
“Biblical characters with this name” line 133: identifies Uzzi as a Benjamite chief and cites 1 Chronicles 9:8.
Set-index list, line 123: “Uzziah, King of Judah, also known as Azariah.” 1 Chronicles 3:12’s Azariah is in the royal line between Amaziah and Jotham.
